title: Boundary dimension estimate on smooth pullback
statement: Under the hypotheses of the boundary normalization theorem, every boundary point y of the smooth pullback C ×_S Spec O(S,s) has stalk Krull dimension at least two.

source.place: Tag 0EYJ, local claim before the formal test

proof.text: Put a = S.fromSpecStalk s and f = pullback.snd c a ≫ a. For a boundary point y, f(y) specializes to s, by specialization to the closed point of Spec O(S,s) and Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint. The pullback condition converts the boundary hypothesis to f(y) outside U. Apply hmin to conclude f(y) = s.

The proved instance Scheme.flat_fromSpecStalk makes a flat. Smoothness of c makes its base change pullback.snd c a smooth and flat; composition makes f flat. The source is locally Noetherian since pullback.snd c a is locally of finite type over Spec O(S,s). Apply depth_eq_add_of_flat_local to the local flat map f.stalkMap y. Nonnegativity of the closed-fibre depth gives depth at y at least depth at f(y) = s, hence at least two.

Apply IsLocalRing.depth_le_supportDim to the Noetherian local stalk at y as a finite nonzero module over itself. Rewrite its support dimension using Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim, coerce the depth bound to WithBot ℕ∞, and compose the inequalities.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYJ, local claim, using Tags 0337 and 00LK; the flat composite to S avoids a separate closed-point stalk equivalence calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem stalk_normalization_boundary_dimension_two_target {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c]
    (U : S.Opens) (s : S)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
      (R := S.presheaf.stalk s) (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    ∀ y : (pullback c a : Scheme.{u}),
      y ∉ (pullback.fst c a) ⁻¹ᵁ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U) →
      (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ringKrullDim ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk y)
